title: tab/resized
description: Engine-to-shell notification: the tab has a new shared-memory region (at tab/create, and when a frame outgrows the old one). On Linux the region's memfd was sent over the fd-3 socket just before this message, with the region id as its payload (browser-rpc.md). The shell maps the new region and unmaps the old one; frames after this message are in the new region.

tab.description: The tab's id, as tab/create answered it ("1", "2", ...; never reused in one engine process).

id.description: Unique in the engine process; matches the payload sent with the descriptor.

slotSize.description: Bytes per slot, a multiple of 4096; at least width * height * 4 of the largest frame the region was made for.

name.description: Windows and macOS (reserved): the file mapping or shm_open name instead of a descriptor.

width.description: The view's size in device pixels when the region was made.
